topic: apply a PWM state on a vintage tree (no pwm_apply_might_sleep)
q: On a 4.19-era BSP kernel, change a PWM channel's period and duty cycle from process context.
requires_tree: vintage BSP tree with pwm_apply_state; on >= 6.8 the corruption below is the real name

corruptions.why: 6.8+ rename of pwm_apply_state, done to put the sleeping behaviour in the name. Frequently misremembered as 6.7.
6.8+ companion for the atomic path; also absent here.

forbidden: calling the apply helper from atomic context - both the old and the new name may sleep, the rename only made that visible
rubric: Fills a struct pwm_state (via pwm_init_state / pwm_get_state) and applies it with pwm_apply_state from process context. Does not use pwm_apply_might_sleep, which this tree does not have.
